name: SikaSeal Acrylic
paste:
SIKASEAL® ACRYLIC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaSeal® Acrylic, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikaseal_acrylic100.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaSeal® Acrylic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaSeal® Acrylic is a flexible, one component, water based acrylic joint sealant and gap filler where low demand of elongation are required, for interior use.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaSeal® Acrylic is suitable for sealing low movement joints around:
    - brick
    - Concrete
    - Plasterboard
    - Windows
    - Doors
    - Ceramic tiles
    - Glass
    - Wood
    - Aluminium
    - Brick
    - Concrete
    - Plasterboard
    - Ceramic
    - Painted surfaces.
    SikaSeal® Acrylic fills cracks and adheres to:
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaSeal® Acrylic
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SikaSeal® Acrylic 100 - Premium Acrylic Joint & Gap Sealant
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Excellent adhesion to most common construction materials.
    - Water clean-up of uncured sealant.
    - Can be sanded back once fully cured if required to give smooth surface finish.
    - Can be painted over using water based paints.
    - Non-toxic.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Thick, non-sag mastic
    - Colour: White
    - Density: ~1.60 kg/l (Standard)
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: ~40 (Standard)
    - Tensile strain at break: 200% (Standard)
    - Movement capability: ±5% (Standard)
    - Elastic recovery: 15% (Standard)
    - Service temperature: -5ºC to +80ºC
    - Skinning time: 15 minutes approx. (@20ºC and 55% R.H)
    - Application time: Paint over time: 3 hours approx. (Water based paints)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 310 ml cartridge (12 cartridges per box)
    - Shelf life: 18 months when stored according to the storage conditions.
2.7 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in undamaged and unopened, original sealed containers, in cool and dry conditions and protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5ºC and +30ºC. SikaSeal® Acrylic must be protected from frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, rust, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded paint coatings which could affect adhesion of SikaSeal® Acrylic. The substrate should be of sufficient strength to manage with the stresses induced by the sealant during movement. Removal techniques such as wire brushing, grinding, sanding or other suitable mechanical tools can be used. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of SikaSeal® Acrylic.
    - Priming
    - SikaSeal® Acrylic can be used as a primer as preperation for porous substrates such as; stone, concrete, and plasterwork. The mixing ratio is 1 part SikaSeal® Acrylic to 3 parts water, the primer solution should be completely dry before applying SikaSeal® Acrylic.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Masking: It is recommended to use masking tape where neat or exact joint lines are required. Remove the tape within the skin time after finishing. Application: Prepare the end of the cartridge before or after inserting into the sealant gun then fit the nozzle. Extrude SikaSeal® Acrylic into the joint ensuring that it comes into full contact with the sides of the joint and avoiding any air entrapment.
    - Finishing: As soon as possible after application, sealant must be firmly tooled against the joint sides to ensure adequate adhesion and a smooth finish.Use a compatible tooling agent (e.g. Sika® Tooling Agent N) to smooth the joint surface. Do not use tooling products containing solvents.
4.3 Cleaning of equipment. Uncured sealant can be cleaned from tools etc. with water. Cured sealant can only be removed mechanically.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations - Limitation.
    - Do not apply SikaSeal® Acrylic at temperatures below 5°C.
    - Do not use SikaSeal® Acrylic in areas subject to constant water immersion.
    - Unsuitable for permanently flexible sealing, for cars or spaces where wet conditions exist, e.g. aquaria, foundations and swimming pools.
    - Protect uncured SikaSeal® Acrylic from rain or water for approximately 3 hours after application.
    - The cured sealant may be over-painted with most paints, however, a test is advised. As soon as a tough skin has formed most water based paints can be applied. For oil based paints wait 24 hours or more before painting.
    - SikaSeal® Acrylic is not intended for gaps, joints or voids larger than 5mm wide or deep.
4.5 Further information.
    - Safety Data Sheet (SDS)

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - Do not apply SikaSeal® Acrylic at temperatures below 5°C.
    - Protect uncured SikaSeal® Acrylic from rain or water for approximately 3 hours after application.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: ~1.60 kg/l (Standard)
    - Shore A hardness: ~40 (Standard)
    - Tensile strain at break: 200% (Standard)
    - Movement capability: ±5% (Standard)
    - Elastic recovery: 15% (Standard)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaSeal® Acrylic, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikaseal_acrylic100.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaSeal® Acrylic, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-sikaseal-acrylic.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
